summary: Troopers arrested a Fairbanks woman on Oct. 26 on domestic violence assault charges and two counts of assault in the presence of a child. Samuel Jasiel Benjamin Malone now faces two felony indecent exposure cases from his Oct. 25 arrests. Dustin Edward Walters is charged with felony theft dated Oct. 25. The weekly charges report for Oct. 20 to 26 lists 50 new criminal cases at Fairbanks and one at Nenana.

entries.title: DV assault arrest: Billie Foltz
body: Billie Foltz, 41, of Fairbanks was arrested on Oct. 26 on domestic violence assault charges and two counts of assault in the presence of a child, troopers say.
Troopers say the assault was reported at about 7:38 p.m. and happened between about midnight and 1 a.m. that day. Alaska State Troopers case AK26106268; no court case has been opened yet.

entries.title: Felony theft charge: Dustin Edward Walters
body: Dustin Edward Walters is charged with second-degree theft, a Class C felony. That means taking property worth $750 to $24,999, punishable by up to five years.
He is also charged with violating a condition of release, a Class B misdemeanor, and cited for driving with a revoked license. The charges are dated Oct. 25 at Fairbanks.
Case 4FA-26-02166CR; preliminary hearings Nov. 5 and Nov. 12.

entries.title: Indecent exposure charges filed: Samuel Jasiel Benjamin Malone
body: Samuel Jasiel Benjamin Malone, 30, is charged in two cases with first-degree indecent exposure with a prior conviction, a Class C felony punishable by up to five years.
The cases follow his two Fairbanks police arrests on Oct. 25. One adds second-degree stalking, a Class A misdemeanor; the other adds violating a condition of release, a Class B misdemeanor.
Cases 4FA-26-02167CR and 4FA-26-02169CR; preliminary hearings Nov. 5 and Nov. 12.

entries.title: DV assault charges: Thomas James Madison Grover
body: Thomas James Madison Grover is charged with fourth-degree assault, recklessly injuring someone, and assault when a child is present. Both are Class A misdemeanors recorded as domestic violence.
The charges are dated Oct. 25 at Fairbanks. Case 4FA-26-02168CR; pre-trial conference Dec. 24.

entries.title: False-name traffic stop arrest: Nicole Noelle Thompson
body: Nicole Noelle Thompson was arrested on Oct. 26 on a warrant and additional charges after troopers say she twice gave another woman's name at traffic stops.
Troopers say she was first stopped for speeding near Johansen Expressway and University Avenue at about 2:15 a.m. on Oct. 25, and stopped again in the same area at about 6:25 a.m. on Oct. 26.
Case 4FA-26-02163CR, charge not yet filed; arraignment Nov. 3.

entries.title: Third theft case: William Howard Frasure
body: William Howard Frasure is charged in a third case with third-degree theft, taking property worth $250 to $749, a Class A misdemeanor dated Oct. 24 at Fairbanks.
